description: Critical user journeys and mandatory/protected test IDs for ShopSphere. Protected test IDs must always be included in any selected regression subset, regardless of diff scope (see docs/test-selection-policy.md).

journeys.name: Catalogue-to-checkout shipping quote
journeys.description: browse catalogue -> navigate to checkout -> select customer type and items -> receive an accurate, accessible shipping quote from the real API

notes: T01 (health mandatory smoke), T05 (mandatory unique boundary/financial coverage), T11 (mandatory end-to-end UI-to-API critical journey), and T12 (mandatory accessibility semantics on the checkout journey) must never be excluded by a selection agent, independent of which files a change touches. T12 additionally carries a SYNTHETIC/fabricated flaky-history signal (test-metadata/synthetic-execution-history.json) that must not be used to justify dropping it -- see docs/test-selection-policy.md.
